title: External artifact refresh after thread-count closure: 4Expert GGUF, SSD sidecar, DFlash/EAGLE drafts

search_method.readme_fetch: README.md via Hugging Face resolve URLs
search_method.partial_header_probe: 64 MiB HTTP range for cloudyu/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-4Expert-GGUF/ds4flash-4expert.gguf; 64 MiB dd header of local accepted native GGUF
search_method.no_full_download_reason: /root has about 2.0 GiB free; smallest relevant full candidate is far larger and no hard-bound cleared 10 tok/s

readme_claims: requires antirez/ds4 4Expert PR; upstream ds4 defaults to 6 active experts and cannot load this GGUF

repos.classification: same Q4KExperts size class as cloudyu; no full download

current_vendor_loadability.routing_name_gap: Current vendor maps LLM_TENSOR_FFN_GATE_TID2EID to blk.%d.ffn_gate_tid2eid and probes tn(LLM_TENSOR_FFN_GATE_TID2EID, i); cloudyu header uses blk.*.ffn_gate_tid2eid.weight.
current_vendor_loadability.q4k_stream_gap: ggml_cuda_moe_stream_one only allows IQ3_XXS by default, or MXFP4/F8_E4M3_B128 with GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_EXPERIMENTAL_DS4. Q4_K routed experts would not use the accepted gate stream/cache path.
current_vendor_loadability.disk_gap: /root has about 2.0 GiB free; the GGUF is 164.47 GB.

hard_bound.derivation: (4 active experts / 6 active experts) * (4.5 MiB Q4_K expert role / 4.25 MiB native MXFP4 expert role)
hard_bound.interpretation: Even granting a source patch that fixes routing tensor naming, adds Q4_K gate stream/pack support, and perfectly eliminates source/page stalls, the top4 Q4_K route is still below 10 tok/s before any integration overhead. Real Q4_K CPU fallback may also be slower than the current MXFP4 x Q8_0 path.

candidate_groups.decision: Do not download or implement 4Expert/Q4K runtime support now. Reopen only with a stronger top4/low-bit artifact whose hard-bound clears 10 tok/s with integration margin, or with measured vendor correctness and a source/page+CPU compute proof above the current threshold.

readme_claims: dense GGUF plus routed expert sidecar
MXFP4 routed expert tensors in layer-major binary banks
requires Flash-MoE aware llama.cpp build with --moe-mode slot-bank and --moe-sidecar

repos.classification: same REAP/162B family as prior 0xSero hard-bound; prompt-quality and vendor slot-bank compatibility unproven

current_vendor_loadability.missing_cli_runtime: Current vendor does not expose --moe-mode slot-bank / --moe-sidecar / Flash-MoE sidecar loading in the accepted path.
current_vendor_loadability.disk_gap: The servantofares dense+sidecar package totals about the same 145+ GiB routed-expert payload as the native model and cannot be downloaded with 2 GiB free.

hard_bound.interpretation: A perfect native SSD sidecar/slot-bank implementation that only eliminates source/page stalls is still below 10 tok/s. It would need the already-rejected CPU fallback compute breakthrough or a stronger representation reduction.

candidate_groups.decision: Do not implement slot-bank sidecar now as a standalone 10 tok/s route. It may be useful only if paired with an independently proven compute/representation reduction that clears the remaining shortfall.

benchmark.note: Requires patched vLLM overlay; README says no llama.cpp support in this release.

current_vendor_loadability.reason: Artifacts are safetensors or PyTorch draft/speculator weights requiring custom vLLM overlays or Speculators support. Current vendor has no DFlash/EAGLE loader, hidden-state capture, verifier scheduling, or tokenizer/vocab adapter for these drafts.

hard_bound.interpretation: DFlash/EAGLE could reopen verifier/draft work only with a concrete vendor verifier path and sublinear target verification. The current vendor fixed-text target path did not show sublinear batch verification, and these artifacts are not standalone GGUF drafts for llama-speculative.

candidate_groups.decision: Do not implement DFlash/EAGLE in vendor now. Reopen only with a vendor-loadable draft/verifier design proving acceptance, verifier cost, RAM/page-cache, VRAM, TTFT, fixed-text top1, and France correctness before coding.

repos.classification: same size/type class as previously bounded antirez/huihui low-bit and MTP artifacts; MTP is optional sidecar, not standalone
same low-bit size class; correctness drift risk from abliterated model; no hard-bound above prior 0xSero 52.6GB candidate
larger than prior 0xSero 52.6GB and not a 10 tok/s hard-bound candidate on the current 32GB GPU
smaller than 86GB IQ2 but still larger than 0xSero 52.6GB; no prompt-quality or vendor loadability proof here

candidate_groups.decision: No recent low-bit GGUF beats the previously strongest 0xSero 52.6GB REAP hard-bound, which was already below 10 tok/s on the current 32GB GPU with required CPU MoE fallback.

next_reopen_conditions: A vendor-loadable draft/verifier artifact with hard-bound acceptance and sublinear target verification sufficient for 10 tok/s
A top4/low-bit GGUF or sidecar representation whose VRAM placement and CPU fallback bound exceeds 10 tok/s with integration margin on the current 32GB RTX 5090
An exact source/page plus CPU compute proof that beats the measured 90.643 GiB/s zero-overhead and integration-overhead thresholds
